phase: Phase C: Trustworthy Numerical Accuracy, Verification Contracts & Intelligent Problem Diagnosis
research_question: Can GDEC automatically produce useful, empirically reliable estimates of spatial discretisation uncertainty for supported engineering quantities of interest, while correctly identifying and refusing computations whose convergence evidence is inadequate?

H5a_empirical_uncertainty_coverage.statistical_interpretation: Empirical acceptance gate; does not establish 95% confidence of >=90% population coverage

H5b_claim_integrity.definition: Among configurations reporting estimated_target_met, E_true <= tol

H6a_estimate_availability.definition: Fraction of eligible Tier 1 configurations receiving a valid uncertainty estimate

H6b_estimate_sharpness.definition: R_U = U0 / E_true for cases where E_true > numerical_floor

H7_refusal_correctness.definition: Fraction of Tier 3 refusal cases returning the exact intended refusal status

H8_tier2_performance.definition: Availability and coverage on Tier 2 difficult and singular elasticity benchmarks
H8_tier2_performance.conditional_scope_narrowing: If H8 fails, restrict contract scope to SMOOTH DISPLACEMENT QOIs ONLY

stop_condition: Freeze protocol and tag prereg-c. DO NOT execute confirmatory 40-configuration runs in this task.
